contexts.text: A dead man... when in no combat... is a slave.

Before (regeneration, man is in) a state of slavery. It is slavery when cupidities and Falsities exercise command... Man never perceives this so long as he is in a state of slavery... When he is in a state of slavery... the man who has been subjugated by cupidities and Falsities supposes that he is in a state of freedom. But this is a gross falsity. Explained. (See AC 905.)
He would spare only those who submitted themselves as vile slaves. AC 1594:3.
A servant of servants shall he be to his brethren () = the vilest thing in the Church. (Explained.)
Those who perform vile services to the men of the Church. Signified, Explained.

Let Canaan be his servant () = that those who place worship solely in externals can perform vile offices... Such persons are not servants in the Church on earth... but they are servants in the other life; for they are among the unhappy. The services which they there perform are vile, and are numerous. Explained.
He said that he wanted to serve them; but... they perceived that he wanted to be great.
donkeys and men-servants () = scientifics regarded in themselves.
All things with the external man are nothing but things of service, that is, they are of service to the internal man...
Every scientific is for the sake of use; and this is its service.

They place eternal happiness in... being served by others... they wanting to serve no one, except for the sake of self... Their saying that they want to serve the Lord alone is false; for those in the love of self want the Lord to serve them; and, so far as this is not done, they recede...

He and his servants () = the rational man and the things in the external man which obeyed... All things in the latter, before it has been liberated, are called servants; for they do nothing but obey the interior man. Example(s).
In order to reign with them, they offer their services with the good Spirits.
Dominion from evil and falsity, is to want to make all slaves.
They shall serve them () = oppression. AC 1849.
The substance of those who undergo temptations, oppressions, afflictions, or slavery. Tr.
This affection... ought to serve intellectual truth... as a maidservant her mistress.
They do not regard others except in so far as they serve them; and those who will not do this they either despise, or hate. AC 2045:2.
When anyone wants to be served, he murders the other in his heart.
As each one wants to be served... there is dissociation... so that they perceive nothing to be more delightful than torturing others...
Thy servant () = the Human... before it was made Divine. Explained, Illustrated.
The Lord then adored Jehovah... like a servant.
The valuation of a servant who was held as vile. Signified. A servant, in the internal sense, = labour.
No one can serve two lords at the same time. (Explained.)
He called all his servants () = rational and scientific things. Explained.
Men-servants and maidservants () = enriched with rational truths and natural truths, and their affections. Explained, Illustrated.
That men-servants = truths, and maidservants, goods, which are of service, and thus serve spiritual and celestial truths and goods. Illustrated.
The laws relating to servants, enumerated.
Servants, in the Word, = the natural things of man which are to be of service to the Rational.
The freedom of the love of self and of the world... is complete slavery. Explained.
No one can know what slavery, or what freedom is, unless he knows the origin of the one and of the other...
To be led by the devil is slavery.
Those are called servants in whom there is no power, or who have power from those (called lords).
Abraham said unto his servant, the elder one of his house () = the ordination and influx of the Lord into His Natural. Explained.
A servant = that which is lower, and serves what is higher; or, that which is exterior, and serves what is interior. All things of the natural man... are nothing but services. AC 3143.
The servant said unto him () = the Lord's perception concerning the natural man. The servant, here, = the natural man. AC 3048. AC 3134. AC 3163, Explained. AC 3169.
The servant took Rebekah () = that Divine natural good initiated. Explained.
She said unto the servant () = exploration from the Divine Natural... The servant = the Divine Natural. AC 3206. AC 3209.
And much service () = truth thence. Service = all that which is beneath, which is subordinate, and which obeys; thus truth, because it... ministers to good. AC 3441:4.
Under Well, see this reference.

Abraham My servant () = the Lord's Divine Human... Servant, when predicated of the Lord, = the Divine Human; not that the Divine Human is a servant, but because the Lord through it is of service to the human race. Explained, Illustrated.
The servants of Isaac () = rational things. Servants = rational, and also scientific, things.
Peoples shall serve thee () = the truths of the Church... To serve, is predicated of truths.
Thou shalt serve thy brother () = that good should be (apparently) in a lower place.
I will serve thee seven years () = study and a holy state... To serve = study. AC 3840. AC 3846. AC 3852.

In relation to the servant who did not want to go out from service... to bore the ear with an awl... = to serve, or obey, perpetually, (thus) not to want to understand truth, but to will truth from obedience...

It was a statute... that the women given to servants belonged to the lord with whom they served, and also the sons born from them. Explained... For a manservant = the truth of the Natural, such as it is at first, before genuine truths are insinuated... When goods and truths have been insinuated through... its service, it is dismissed... To represent this, this law about servants was delivered. But Jacob was not a bought servant... AC 4113, Explained.
I have served thee for them () = from Own power; for to serve = labour and study, which, predicated of the Lord, = Own power. AC 4076. AC 4176.
Thou knowest my service with which I have served thee () = labour and study from Own power.
How I have served () = to know his power; fur to serve, here, = Own power. AC 3996.
See Maidservant. AC 5023. AC 9034. AC 9062. AC 9081. TCR 325. AE 1022:2.
Men-servants = scientifics, which are the truths of the natural man. AC 4244.
That the things in the Natural be servient.
Truths are then only ministers and servants (to good).
Services general and special. Signified, Explained.
Servants () = the things of the natural man. Explained.
Thy servant Jacob ()... = submission; for truth is relatively a servant, before conjunction.
Things servient. Signified.
Servants () = those who know.
Believe all others to be relatively servants, vile.

A Hebrew man = a servant... For such regard spiritual truth and good as a mere servant; for, with them... the spiritual serves; when yet... the Natural ought to serve. Explained. AC 5023. AC 5025, Signified, Explained.
The joy in Heaven is to serve by doing good to others...
When exteriors begin to serve interiors...
Made a feast to all his servants () = conjunction with the exterior Natural... Servants = the things of the exterior Natural. Explained. AC 5164.
Mutual love causes it not to be perceived as servitude.

In the Word, all things are called servants which are beneath, and subordinate: the exterior Natural relatively to the interior Natural; this relatively to the Rational; and all things in man relatively to the Divine. AC 5305.

The servants, here, were the princes and nobles... Relatively to the Lord, all are equally servants. In Heaven the greatest are servants more than others, because they are in the greatest obedience and humility. Illustrated.
Servants are so called relatively to the Divine truth which... ministers relatively to the Divine good.

The reason the last who are the first are servants above others, is that they perceive that all their life and Power are from the Lord... Those who do not perceive this are also servants, but more in mouth than heart. While those in the contrary call themselves servants but want to be lords...
A servant is predicated of truth; here () = truth inservient.
Servants = the things in the Natural, especially those in the exterior Natural.
Servants = lower things; hence truths; for... things subject are called servants...
Take us for servants () = things of no account.
In Heaven... no one regards another as a servant; but each wants to minister and be inservient.
We will be... for servants () = without freedom from proprium. AC 5763, Explained. AC 5786, Signified, Explained. AC 6138, Signified, Explained. AC 6163. AC 6568.
He is a servant of the devil. Explained.
When man receives this freedom, he is a servant of the Lord.
Freedom from proprium is... to subject others as servants...
Servants, here () = lowest things.
The service (of lower things). Signified, Explained... Lower things are formed for no other use than to be services. Explained.
Many things of service (sent to spiritual good). Signified, Explained. AC 5959.
He who introduces himself into a man's cupidities and persuasions... makes him a slave.
To redeem, as predicated of slavery. (Explained.)
A bony donkey = the lowest service. Explained.
In the other life (they who do good for a recompense) are employed as lowest services.
All slavery is from the affection of the love of self and the world.
To serve in lowest things. Signified.
Being served by others supposed to be happiness. AC 6393:2.
They do good... from affection for self, which is slavery.
Whereas heavenly bliss is... not to be served by others; but to want to serve others. Illustrated.
A servant unto tribute () = to be subject and to serve. Explained.
All the servants of Pharaoh () = the scientifics of the Natural.
The servants of the God of thy father () = the acknowledgement of the Divine things of the Church. Explained.
Falsities which would compel them to serve. Signified, Explained.
The Egyptians made them serve () = intention to subjugate. Explained. AC 6668. AC 6670. AC 6800. AC 7204.
Aid against those who want to compel them to serve. Signified, Explained.
Thy servant () = the Human not yet made Divine.
That they may serve Me () = elevation into Heaven to perform uses thence. Explained.
Let the service be made heavy () = the assault increased. Explained.
Service () = assault by falsities; thus infestation. AC 7151, AC 7218.
A servant = one who ministers, and performs duty. AC 7144.
To serve Jehovah () = to worship the Lord. AC 7349. AC 7439. AC 7500. AC 7641. AC 7654. AC 7658. AC 7668. AC 7722. AC 7730. AC 7958.
Would make truths serve evils of life.
The servants and people of Pharaoh = all things in the Natural. The things there which are inservient to confirm falsities are called servants. AC 7357. (Compare AC 7396.) AC 7448. AC 7543. AC 7632.
The servants of Pharaoh = the things of the natural mind. AC 7563. AC 7565.
The servants of Pharaoh = those who infest of a lower sort. AC 7773, Explained. AC 7787. AC 8143.
He loves self as a means to the end that he may serve the Lord... and the world as a means that he may serve the neighbour.
Ye shall keep this service () = worship on account of deliverance. AC 7936. AC 8057.
Every man's servant () = man as yet natural.
The house of servants () = spiritual captivity... For service = infestation by falsities. AC 8866, Explained.
To serve the Egyptians () = to surrender themselves to those who infest. AC 8169.
Moses His servant () = Divine truth ministering. Explained.
I will divide the spoil = slavery. Explained. AC 8293.
Those in charity want to serve all as the lowest; whereas those in faith (only)... want to be served by all.
In man, what ought to dominate is inservient; and what ought to serve, dominates.
It is slavery to be led by those in Hell. References.
Thou shalt not serve them () = no Divine worship for them. To serve = submission... To serve (as distinguished from to bow down to) = worship from the truth of faith.
Thy man-servant () = the Natural as to truth. References.
Truths and goods... then come into a state of slavery. Signified, Explained.
A man-servant = the affection of spiritual truth.

When thou shalt buy a Hebrew servant () = those in the Church who are in truths of doctrine, and not in good according to them. Explained... A servant is predicated of those in truth and not in the corresponding good; and, in general, of truth relatively to good.
The reason these are represented by servants, is that the things of the External Church are, relatively, nothing but services...
The reformation of such is treated of here in the laws concerning man-servants and maidservants.
Six years shall he serve () = a state of labour and of some combat, and of the consequent confirmation of truth. AC 8981.
In the seventh he shall go out free () = a state of confirmed truth. Explained.

If he came in his body (that is, a man-servant alone without a woman) () = truth without delight... The men of the External Church, represented by the Hebrew servants, are those who learn truth from no delight. Explained.
These are meant by those who want to serve for ever. Explained. (See also AC 8985-8991. AE 208:13.)
These are the arcana in these statutes concerning servants. Explained.
If he be lord of a woman () = truth conjoined with delight.
An (Israelitish) man-servant = the man of the External Church, possessed of the truth of doctrine, but not the corresponding good; because he does truth and good (merely) to be rewarded. Explained.
Thus the man of the External Church is relatively a servant... and was represented by the servant called a Hebrew servant, because he was bought from the sons of Israel.

The man-servants, here, = (those) in a delight which counterfeits the corresponding good... Their going out from service (with their woman) = their state when received into Heaven; but as they are solely in faith... they are admitted no further than the entrance. Explained.
If his lord shall give him a woman () = good adjoined to truth by the Spiritual, while in combat. Explained. (See also AC 8983-8991.)
Those who act solely from obedience... are relatively in servitude. Explained.
But to serve the Lord by acting according to His precepts, and thus by obeying Him, is not to be a servant, but is to be free. Explained.

He shall serve him for ever () = to obey to eternity... Such can never be brought to a state in which they act from good... They are perfected as to obedience; but do not attain to anything of charity. (See AC 3869:11.)
For all that which derives its origin from the love of self, or the love of the world... is servile.
Those in truth and not in the affection of it... are represented by the man-servants from the sons of Israel.
A man-servant = scientific truth, which is the truth of the literal sense. Explained. (This smitten. Explained.)
(The Angels) place all glory and joy in serving; and, when in this state, they are in dominion. Explained.

When a man shall smite the eye of his man-servant () = if the internal injures the truth of faith in the external man... A man-servant = scientific truth in the external man, thus also the external man. (See also AC 9060-9063.)
A man-servant = truth in the Natural. (This destroyed. Explained.)

No one can serve two lords... = to serve the Lord by faith, and the world by love; thus to acknowledge truth, and do evil. ( = those called Luke-warm. AC 9210:3. AE 233.) AE 409:7. AE 730:3, Explained.
Slavery is to be led by cupidities which are from Hell. References.
Submission and service. Signified, Explained.
Good done for the sake of gain must serve.
To serve = obedience, and also worship. References.
To serve = worship. AC 9347.
Serving the neighbour for the sake of the neighbour (a sign that sins are remitted).
To do evil from delight is (really) slavery... Everyone who does sin is the servant of sin. NJHD 142. AE 409:9.
The service of the Habitation... Service = the External or Natural of man, Explained.
Servant is predicated from truths.
Those not in this good of love... are in a state of slavery. Explained.
Slavery is to be led by self. DP 44.
The governors there minister and serve; for to do good to others from the love of good is to serve, and to provide that it be done is to minister.
Where one is a slave, the other also is led as a slave by the cupidity of dominating.
Heaven consists in serving others for the sake of their happiness...
He who is in the love of self, wills that the Church, his country, etc., should serve him, and not he them.
He who dominates from love... loves nothing more than uses, thus to serve others. To serve others means to will good and perform uses to them.
When he serves others, it is that he may himself be served...
(In Hell they punish a new infernal) until he has been reduced to slavery... But those who have been made slaves are (by turns) taken out [of slavery] to help some new devil to subjugate others.
See Servant.
To be led by evil is (really) slavery. (Explained.)
Infernal freedom, in itself, is slavery. DP 145:end. DP 149:2.

Man does not want to come out of spiritual servitude (as he does out of natural servitude) because he does not know what spiritual servitude is... It is believed that spiritual servitude is freedom, and spiritual freedom servitude. (Other reasons given.)
Domination is thus to them a means of doing uses, thus of serving.
His servants () = those in faith from charity, or in truths of wisdom from good of love. Explained, Illustrated. AR 347, Signified, Explained. AE 6. AE 427.
Therefore servants = truths.
As the Lord was the Divine truth... He is called the Servant of Jehovah. Illustrated.
As a servant = one who teaches Divine truth.
All in the Spiritual Kingdom are called the Lord's servants, and those in the Celestial Kingdom, ministers; (for) good ministers, and truth is inservient. AR 128. AE 155:5. AE 478:end.
In the opposite, servants = those who serve the devil: these are in slavery itself; whereas those who serve the Lord are in a state of freedom.
A servant of God = one in truths. AR 134.
The infernals know not but that they had been slaves (here).
Servants = those who are in such things from others, thus from memory. AR 604. AR 832.
They serve Him day and night () = live constantly and faithfully according to the truths they receive from him. ( = to be kept in truths. AE 478.)
A servant, in the Word, = one who is, or that which is, of service; here, for life.
His servants () = the worshippers of the Lord. ( = all who are in truths of faith. AR 809.)
His servants shall minister to Him () = that those in truths from the Word will be with Him and will do His commandments, because they are conjoined.
His servants () = those in truths from the Lord.
The Prince said, I am the servant of my Society, because I am of service to it by doing uses.
(Author) By Emanuel Swedenborg, a servant of the Lord Jesus Christ...
Servants = those not conjoined with the Lord.
Freedom which is from Hell is slavery. (Explained.)
A state of spiritual servitude, described. From experience.
An Angel, on hearing the word servant, put it on, and prayed from it...
Those who labour they suppose to be servants. Described.
Evil Spirits regard man as a vile slave. Explained.
Those led by Him long to serve even the worst; even if their enemies. Explained.
Such call themselves servants of servants; yet claim all Power.

He who supposes that he thinks, etc. from himself, is most a servant; and in the eyes of other Spirits is scarcely (so much as) a slave; for they can use him as a dead instrument... Still, they are willing to be viler than servants in the eyes of others, provided they seem lords in their own.
Evil Spirits can speak good, and thus serve. (Explained.)
Those who have served (here) have acquired a life of obeying...
They dwell solitary... with their manservants and maidservants, who are all in marriage.
Servants of God = those who hearken to and obey God.
The state becomes servile, when good does not lead. Treated of.
To believe what another says is servile...
The servants () = the Word given through Moses and the prophets.
A servant = whatever is inservient, thus truth.
Those who make them serve = falsities.
Servants of the Lord = those who receive goods and truths from Him.
Servants rule over us () = evils and falsities... ( = when the natural man dominates. AE 654:61.)
My servants () = those in truths from good.
Every bondman () = the natural man. (Explained.)

Servant does not imply servitude, but being of service, and effecting... Hence servant is said not only of the natural man relatively to the spiritual, but also of men who perform a work for others, and of the Angels who effect the mandates of God; nay, of the Lord Himself as to the Divine Human, when (here); and also of truths from good, because good acts and effects through truths... Illustrated.
But if only the natural man is open, the whole man is a servant in the common sense. Explained.
As the Lord as to the Divine truth is called a servant, those are called servants who are in Divine truth, and are of service to others thereby. Illustrated.
Disciple = good; servant, truth.
Not servants, but friends () = those who receive Divine truth in doctrine and life.
The elect = those in charity; servants, those in truths from the good of love. AE 684:20.
To serve is said of those in truths.

Therefore those in the affection of truth constantly serve Him... The affection within, serves; and this is the service which the Lord wants... To serve the Lord is to be in truths, and to act sincerely and justly in every Thing...
Out of the house of bondage. Explained.
Servant () = those in truths. AE 695.
The Lord is called a servant from being of service and ministering, that is, performing uses.
Slavery is to do good from self.
Bondmen = those who think from others, and do not see whether a thing is true or false, but still acknowledge it as true.
The servants of the Lord () = those in truths from good.
The blood of His servants () = violence to those in truths from Him.
Praise God all His servants () = worship by those in truths.
He thus serves two lords.
They do not spurn serving, because everyone ought to serve...
To instruct children and servants (an external of worship).
